blockers: CORE_CAUSAL_MODEL_DISTORTED remains in the learner-facing design chain. Although the binary hotel-first win condition is now repeatedly disclosed as a game-design operationalization, game_translations_v2.json and play_seeds_v2.json still teach that only the hotel has time-sensitive consequences. Research establishes only that this review found specific hospitality evidence for the hotel; it expressly documents real bus constraints and lacks comparable case-specific data for the other parties. Absence of confirmed comparable data is not proof that those parties have no time sensitivity.

failure_codes.finding: The repair appropriately labels hotel-first as a simplified binary game rule and avoids an invented numeric threshold, but the intended takeaway still says the hotel alone is time-sensitive. This repeats the round-1 exclusivity overclaim in another part of the current design chain and would teach an unsupported real-world conclusion to the player.
